about: CBZ Capital is the investment banking and corporate advisory arm of CBZ Holdings. It structures and lead-arranges debt syndications and corporate bond issues, advises on mergers, acquisitions and restructurings, sponsors listings on the ZSE and VFEX, and arranges public-private partnership infrastructure finance.

faq.a: It structures and lead-arranges debt syndications and bond issues, advises on mergers, acquisitions and restructurings, sponsors listings on the ZSE and VFEX, and arranges public-private partnership finance.

faq.q: Can you take my company to market?
faq.a: Yes. CBZ Capital advises on and sponsors IPOs, listings, rights issues and private placements on the ZSE and VFEX.
Start a capital enquiry with the company, what you need and the approximate size, and a senior banker comes back within two working days.

productsNote: Transaction advisory, capital raising and syndication terms are tailored to each mandate and subject to regulatory approvals.
